[b][sub]Official notice of the request of a state visit of Rosenmarkke, Vespurias, and the Government of the Confederal Kingdom of Floueschia in Vespurias to the Second Flouesch Republic  [/sub][/b]

From: Secretary of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter

To my dear compatriots and counterparts in the Republic of Rosenmarkke and the Commonwealth of Vespurias. And to the gentlemen in charge of the forigen affairs of the royalist government in exile. I hope this letter finds you well.

As all of our nations have come to be good friends on the international stage, united in a clear vision for the future of Erene. The government of the Second Flouesch Republic would like to request a formal state visit by the heads of state of your respective natons be made to the Second Flouesch Republic to strengthen trilateral relations between our nations. The meeting will be held in Republik Haus, the residence of the incumbent First Consul, Friedrich Müller, which is located in Téiernsbuer. Dinner, protection, and a tour of the city will be offered at our expense. 

Most sincerely, Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter,

After Mr X's statement and question to the Sikirskian authorities, the Sikirskians simply went blank and just started at the diplomatic team. It was dead silent, a literally pin dropped by Mr G. Quagmire in his holding cell could be heard. 

"Hello? Hello? Soooo what do you think?" said by a confused Mr X

The Sikirskians just continued with their blank starting and this began to unsettle the diplomatic team. "Let's go" stating one of the team to Mr X who replied with a short but stern "Sure". As they began to walk out of the room, while the heads of the Sikirskians turned as they watched them leave, one of the team says, "What about Quagmire?!?!? We can't leave him here, causing a diplomatic problem with the potential offspring he'll have in Sikirsk". "You're right, we need to rescue him" replied Mr X

As the team began to descend down the building to rescue Mr G. Quagmire they notice the guards are gone, but to their surprise, a few of the female secretaries are seen in Quagmire's cell. The team let out a collective sighs are let before Mr X grabs him by the shoulder, whispering "let's go Quagmire, there's a pleasure ship waiting for us". "Can we bring these ladies to it? Ciggity Ciggity" replied Quagmire as he tried to grab one of the Sikirskian secretaries but Mr X bluntly replied to him with a stern "No". The team made it out of the building and quickly made it to the pier where the HMS Godiva was docked out to ensure that Quagmire didn't stray far and "try" with local women. 

Once aboard the ship, it was unclear as to where they will head next. As the HMS Godiva departed the dock and sailed into the sunset, there was some confusion. While unable to directly head back to the NBE, they decided that a nearby nation would probably best not only for continued diplomacy, but also ..... THE FUN OF THE PLEASURE SHIPS WOOOHOOOO!!!
